oik.t: n. [英][口]乡巴佬, 蠢货, 粗人

oil.t:
n. 油, 石油, 油画颜料
vt. 涂油于, 使融化成油状, 加油于
vi. 加燃油, 融化
oil.d:
n. a slippery or viscous liquid or liquefiable substance not miscible with water
n. oil paint containing pigment that is used by an artist

oil slick.t: n. 浮油; 漂浮在水面上的油膜

oil tanker.t:
油轮
[经] 油轮, 油罐车, 加油非机

oilcloth.d: n. cloth treated on one side with a drying oil or synthetic resin

oiled.t:
a. 涂油的, 用油防水的, 浸油的
[机] 涂油的, 擦油

oiler.t:
n. 油商, 加油工, 涂油者, 注油壶
[化] 加油器; 加油者
oiler.d: n. a worker who oils engines or machinery

oilfield.d: n. a region rich in petroleum deposits (especially one with producing oil wells)

oiliness.t: n. 油质, 滑溜, 圆滑, 浸油
oiliness.d:
n consisting of or covered with oil
n smug self-serving earnestness

oilman.t: n. 石油工人, 石油商
oilman.d:
n. a person who owns or operates oil wells
n. a worker who produces or sells petroleum

oilseed.d: n. any of several seeds that yield oil

oilskin.t: n. 油布, 油布雨衣
oilskin.d: n. a macintosh made from cotton fabric treated with oil and pigment to make it waterproof

oily.t:
a. 油的, 油滑的, 油嘴的
[化] 油的; 含油的; 油性的; 油质的; 多油的; 油腻的; 油滑的
oily.d: s. coated or covered with oil

oink.t: n. 猪叫声, 呼噜声
oink.d:
n the short low gruff noise of the kind made by hogs
v utter a high-pitched cry, characteristic of pigs

ointment.t:
n. 软膏, 油膏
[化] 软膏; 药膏
ointment.d: n. semisolid preparation (usually containing a medicine) applied externally as a remedy or for soothing an irritation
